newsitem.title: USA: DC council chair pleased by control board vote.
newsitem.headline: DC council chair pleased by control board vote.

text.p: Linda Cropp, acting chairman of the District of Columbia Council, said she is "extremely pleased" at Thursday's passage by the city's financial control board of a fiscal 1998 budget for D.C.
"The financial authority accepted almost 99 percent of the budget passed by the council," Cropp said following Thursday's vote.

Cropp also congratulated the council for adopting a balanced city budget one year ahead of a deadline set by the control board. "No other city that had a financial authority has done so well so soon," Cropp said.
